observations: Full 1024px colored original and native 344px unpainted phone preview inspected individually. Toucan silhouette, eye, beak, chest, tail and two feet remain recognizable; three leaves and repeated black/beak regions support matching.

Six substantial paintable groups: black plumage/beak tip/tail, brown branch, green leaves, orange beak, yellow face and pale gray chest. Black is a large subject fill here, not a count of outline ink; chest is a substantial subject region, not background. Fixed blue feet do not count as paintable variety. This is a borderline chromatic spread relative to the approved toucan source, but not a two/three-color asset.

All 11 four-connected paintable components have exactly one matching number. All 10px digits are readable at native phone size; minimum map-center clearance 7.58 screen pixels. Yellow eye-patch label is snug but separate from eye/outline.
Fixed blue feet, brown branch sections and eye highlight agree exactly with the current original RGB. Zero fixed-color mismatches; this does not excuse the unfilled background pocket.
defects: Visible enclosed unfilled background pocket between the upper/right leaves and branch has no number and no fixed fill. map.png is 255 and lines.png alpha is zero for 188 pixels, bbox [703,643,29,17] in the 1024px asset (approximately [236.2,216.0,9.7,5.7] at 344px). It is visible as a small gray triangular gap in the phone preview. This violates the requested every-visible-enclosure rule despite all paintable map components being labeled. Fix as appropriate fixed background or an accessible numbered region; do not squeeze a 10px label into this pocket.
bundle_hash_algorithm: SHA256 filename UTF-8 bytes followed by file bytes in listed order, without delimiters
scope: Current final processed visual artifact gate only. Existing exact-hash source/video PASS records checked via promote.approved. No integration or new video visual approval.
inspection_method: Individually viewed full-size original.png, native-size unpainted phone-preview.png and full-size lines.png. Also viewed approved source for 39. Existing phone previews verified pixel-for-pixel against current data/lines; missing 39 preview generated with phone_previews.py --final. Sequential lightweight NumPy/PIL/OpenCV checks, cv2 threads capped at 2.
limitations: Phone preview uses PIL Noto Sans Bold 10px at a 344px canvas width; native UI/Skia and touch interaction not tested.
Reward videos not visually re-reviewed; relied on current exact-hash source/video PASS records.
